lines.text: در قصبه اشرف که از مضافات ولایت مازندران است این قضیه بعرض پادشاه ظل الله رسانید
lines.en: In the town of Ashraf, which is among the dependencies of the province of Mazandaran, this matter was brought to the attention of the King, the Shadow of God.

lines.text: و گفتم که درین باب دغدغه بخاطر اشرف نرسد که طالع این دولت قوی است و نوعی دیگر نمیتواند
lines.en: And I said that in this matter, no anxiety should reach the noble mind, for the ascendant of this state is strong, and it cannot be otherwise.

lines.text: شد از قضا بعد از چهار پنج ماه حضرت شیخ مریض شده و در عرض یکهفته برحمت ایزدی پیوست
lines.en: By chance, after four or five months, His Eminence the Shaykh became ill, and within a week, he joined the divine mercy.

lines.text: و در همان سال شیخ محمد نبیره شیخ زین الدین که در کمال زهد و علم بود و جماعتی کثیره اجتهاد
lines.en: And in that same year, Shaykh Muhammad, the grandson of Shaykh Zayn al-Din, who was in the perfection of asceticism and knowledge, and a large group [acknowledged] his ijtihad,

lines.text: او را در مذهب امامیه قبول و اذعان نموده بودند و در ولایت حجاز از دار مجاز بعالم
lines.en: had accepted and acknowledged him in the Imami sect, and in the province of Hijaz, from the abode of metaphor to the world

lines.text: حقیقت انتقال نمود و نیز در همان سال قیصر روم سلطان عثمان لشکر بر سر فرنگیان
lines.en: of reality he transferred [i.e., died]. And also in that same year, the Caesar of Rome, Sultan Uthman, drew an army against the Franks.

lines.text: کشیده در انوقت که خبر ان عزیمت در ایران انتشار یافت بعرض اشرف رسانیدم که
lines.en: At that time, when the news of that expedition spread in Iran, I brought it to the noble attention that

lines.text: فرنگیان غالب خواهند شد اتفاقا در ان غزا شکست یافته مغلوب و منکوب مراجعت نمود
lines.en: the Franks would be victorious. By chance, in that campaign, he was defeated, and returned vanquished and afflicted.

lines.text: (تنبیه) استاد ابی ریحان بیرونی از براهم هند نقل کرده است که هرگاه افتاب بنقطه
lines.en: (Warning) The master Abu Rayhan al-Biruni has transmitted from the Brahmins of India that whenever the sun reaches the point

lines.text: اول حمل واصل شود و قمر در منازل زهره باشد یعنی بطین و دبران و عوا و اخبیه در ان سال
lines.en: of the beginning of Aries, and the moon is in the mansions of Venus, meaning al-Butayn, al-Dabaran, al-Awwa, and al-Akhbiya, in that year

lines.text: اگر میان اهل اسلام و شرک جنگی افتد مشرکان فایق ایند فلنرجع الی ما کنا بصدده
lines.en: if a war occurs between the people of Islam and polytheism, the polytheists will prevail. So let us return to what we were about.

lines.text: (رجعت مریخ در برج قوس) دلالت کند بر کثرت بلا و ضرر بروز دار و کتاب و عروض شر
lines.en: (The retrogradation of Mars in the sign of Sagittarius) indicates the abundance of affliction and harm to the viziers and scribes, and the occurrence of evil

lines.text: و فساد و عروض سرفه و درد سینه (رجعت مریخ در برج جدی) دلالت کند بر نا استواری
lines.en: and corruption, and the occurrence of coughs and chest pain. (The retrogradation of Mars in the sign of Capricorn) indicates the instability

lines.text: کارهای مردم و فساد مزاجها و عروض غموم و هموم در خلایق و مرگ اشراف و رنج
lines.en: of people's affairs, the corruption of temperaments, the occurrence of griefs and anxieties among the creatures, the death of nobles, and the suffering

lines.text: سپاهیان و فساد حیوانات و کژدم و جستن باد سموم (رجعت مریخ در برج دلو)
lines.en: of soldiers, the corruption of animals and scorpions, and the blowing of the simoom wind. (The retrogradation of Mars in the sign of Aquarius)

lines.text: دلالت کند بر خروج جمعی از رعایا که پادشاه را از ان فکر و بیم دست دهد و میوه را از
lines.en: indicates the rebellion of a group of subjects, which will cause the king thought and fear, and the fruit from

lines.text: باد ضرر رسد (رجعت مریخ در برج حوت) دلالت کند بر حزن پادشاه و کدورت
lines.en: the wind will suffer harm. (The retrogradation of Mars in the sign of Pisces) indicates the sorrow of the king and the turbidity

lines.text: و اضطراب خلایق و نقل یکی از پادشاهان از مکانی بمکانی و از مأمن بالضروره جدا
lines.en: and agitation of the creatures, and the transfer of one of the kings from one place to another, and necessarily separated from a place of safety,

lines.text: شدن و ناامیدی مردم و نتاج اگرم گوید فائده و منفعت مردم و تندرستی انان (تنبیه) حکیم
lines.en: and the despair of the people, and the offspring, if he says, the benefit and profit of the people and their health. (Warning) The sage,

lines.text: فاضل و راصد کامل محی الدین مغربی فرموده که رجوع ثلثه علویه در وقت واحد دلالت
lines.en: the learned and perfect observer Muhyi al-Din al-Maghribi has stated that the retrogradation of the three superior planets at the same time indicates

lines.text: واضحه دلالت کند بر تغییر دولت و موت ملوک و در سنه هزار و هشت هجری این وضع
lines.en: clearly indicates the change of state and the death of kings. And in the year one thousand and eight Hijri, this situation

lines.text: روی داد چون طالع مملکت بلخ و ولایت مرو بطول نحسین در انوقت منحوس شده
lines.en: occurred. Since the ascendant of the kingdom of Balkh and the province of Marv, due to the length of the two infortunes, had become inauspicious at that time,

lines.text: بود بعرض پادشاه ظل الله رسانیدم که در این دو ولایت تغییر دولت ممکن است اتفاقا
lines.en: I brought it to the attention of the King, the Shadow of God, that in these two provinces a change of state is possible. By chance,

summary.headline: Mars Retrograde in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological examples of royal and military predictions in Ashraf, Mazandaran, including Shaykh Muhammad’s death and Sultan Uthman’s defeat, followed by al-Biruni’s rule concerning the Sun, Moon, and wars. Interpretations of Mars retrograde in Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces describe political upheaval, illness, deaths, weather, and harm to rulers and subjects, with Muhyi al-Din al-Maghribi’s doctrine on simultaneous retrogradation of the superior planets.
